name: typer
description: Autonomous manga and comics typesetting in Photoshop through TypeR tools.

interface.longDescription: Let an LLM inspect manga pages, detect and order speech bubbles, map script lines, select typography, shape and center text, review layers, save, and move through a chapter with TypeR.
defaultPrompt: Use TypeR to inspect and typeset the current manga page.
Review the current page, correct its bubble-to-dialogue mapping, and finish the typeset.
